assessments.mechanism: Use high-information verifier/compiler diagnostics for iterative repair instead of pure independent resampling.
assessments.clean_scope: Goedel-Prover-V2 Lean theorem proving; long-context/token cost means pass count alone is not compute matching.
assessments.o_comparison: O routes failed/uncertain units back to fresh Root and retains objective evidence, so conditional repair exists at a generic task level. It has not implemented Lean compiler-diagnostic repair or the reported pass@K/self-correction scheme.

assessments.mechanism: Use semantic/structural sample diversification when RL policy mode collapse is detected, but gate it because the same intervention can hurt SFT policies.
assessments.clean_scope: Lean theorem proving; tactic-skeleton forcing helps one RL-trained prover and hurts an SFT prover under the reported matched setup.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly values heterogeneous exploration and measured a width-3 sibling-checkpoint adaptation versus width-1 on three tasks; that exact adaptation was rejected for higher invocation count. O did not test RL mode-collapse diagnostics or tactic-skeleton structural diversity, so only a related exploration-width mechanism is tested.

assessments.mechanism: Use executable Lean process feedback as dense process-level RL credit assignment, concentrating credit at decision-boundary tokens.
assessments.clean_scope: Theorem-proving RL evidence; gains vary by model/benchmark/budget and are not uniformly monotone.
assessments.o_comparison: O has deterministic task evaluation but no token-level RL/process-reward training from Lean or another executable verifier.

assessments.mechanism: Hierarchically decompose long verified-code proof obligations and use cheap structural rejectors before expensive completion.
assessments.clean_scope: Verified-code proof benchmarks; raw hierarchical-vs-whole-proof headline is not compute matched and RL is a smaller refinement.
assessments.o_comparison: O already decomposes work into falsifiable units and uses preflight/protected regression/fail-closed checks before expensive or active changes. It does not implement formal-proof decomposition, quickcheck/proof-reconstruction ranking, or the cited verified-code search.

assessments.mechanism: Jointly plan implementation and proof obligations before committing, rather than build-then-prove sequentially.
assessments.clean_scope: P^3 Lean verification benchmarks/frontier-model backends; one run per task/model/method cell and transfer to smaller models is untested.
assessments.o_comparison: No joint program-and-formal-proof planning mechanism matching P^3 was found in O.
